SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-21-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-21-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. 506 PLAINTIFF TAO LIANG IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED MANDARIN INTERPRETER AIDONG NI. DEFENDANT DUANE PERRY IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-21-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LIANG, TAO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT PERRY, DUANE J LANDLORD'S PHOTOGRAPHIC EVIDENCE SUBSTANTIATES THE UNIT CONDITIONS AND THE NEED FOR REPAIRS. TENANT MAY CASH THE $3808.48 CHECK IN HER POSSESSION BUT LANDLORD IS NOT LIABLE FOR FURTHER SECURITY DEPOSIT REIMBURSEMENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
